text: Cool, still, damp air, with an occasional faint droplet. Almost silent, more a change in the room than a sound.
The quiet of a misty morning: soft, damp, motionless air with a very faint drip now and then.
A barely audible, cool, moist hush in the air, gentle and still, even in volume throughout.
One short, deep, heavy push of force: a single dull thump of great weight shoving outward, brief and soft at the end.
A quick, low, solid shove of stone and earth, one deep thud that is over at once.
A heavy body bracing to charge: one short, muffled, deep burst of weight.
One soft, warm puff of bright living energy: a quick gentle bloom that opens at once and fades.
A short, tender burst of healing light, warm and round, opening immediately and melting away.
A small, bright, gentle pulse of life energy, one soft warm pop that fades quickly.
One quick, light whoosh of air, small and crisp: a soft flick of speed.
A short, clean snap of moving air, light and fast, gone at once.
A subtle, swift puff of wind, like someone darting away, small and airy.
A very faint, soft flutter of moving air, barely there, light and quick, even in volume throughout.
The gentlest rush of air moving past someone walking quickly, quiet, smooth and constant.
A light, subtle hum of energy in the air, soft and quick, staying low and steady.
A low, steady, unbroken rumble of heavy things being pushed aside, even in volume throughout.
The continuous muffled rolling of a great weight moving steadily forward, smooth, constant and quiet.
A deep, soft, constant grind of earth shouldering its way ahead, steady from start to end.
